# Dockview 8.8.3 — shared asset

The frozen Demo uses the production asset at `web/js/vendor/dockview-core.min.js`.
Version, integrity and license belong to [vendor-manifest](../../../../web/vendor-manifest.json)
and [upstream license/provenance](../../../../web/licenses/dockview-8.8.3/).
No second bundle or loader. The preview server exposes the same static file.
